evidence.M1: R1-01 quotes the same 'did not answer the second CO-A2' row: 'The spec row skips the re-read after the second timeout and bans CO-A3, so an order that the second call did cancel gets no refund' (Round 3 Q4 re-read procedure), and notes CO-S15's failing lookups mean scenarios do not catch it.
evidence.M2: R1-02 cites CO-S17 row 3 injecting OrderNotCancelled while Final state asserts 'HG-10482 has status cancelled', and says row 103's 'tell the customer the order is cancelled ... refund not issued' handling has no input ('only added as an outcome in the tool confirmation turn, change 2').
evidence.M7: R1-05 on G-02 and the 'changed ... in the confirming turn or after confirming' row: 'No scenario has the customer confirm and change in the same turn ... or change after confirming', citing CO-S03's 'confirms nothing' note.
evidence.M8: R1-10 (Failure handling; CO-01 / CO-02): 'Nothing covers a customer who names no order ... and has no order with status placed or processing ... no rule says what to tell the customer, and no scenario tests the case', citing the checklist's 'more than one plausible match, or none'. It covers the no-open-order side (b) only, not the single-open-order side (a).
evidence.M9: R1-04 quotes the Scope bullet 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives': 'No CO-xx rule carries it ... no rubric dimension in §5.2 ... checks for it ... An agent that says "your refund will arrive in 5-10 business days" passes every scenario.'
evidence.M10: R1-07 on the 'status cancelled' row and CO-S06: an already-cancelled order with a failed or missing refund gets only 'already cancelled', 'exactly the end state CO-S23 leaves when both handoffs time out'; CO-S06 tests only an issued refund.
evidence.M13: R2-L3 quotes the same CO-S03/CO-S04 Turn 2 trigger and says it is not a §5.1-defined event: 'A partial question such as asking only whether to cancel HG-10482 could therefore trigger Turn 2 under one conversion but not another.'
